description: How this project is built and run on Modelence Cloud.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor validation. The version in it names the format version the file is written for: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelence/modelence/main/schema/v1/modelence.config.json

resources.description: Everything this app is made of, by the name you give it. Exactly one resource is supported today.

type.description: What this resource is. "service": a Node.js app built from this repository.

image.description: Base image: node-<version>-<variant>, with a Node.js major ("node-22-slim") or exact version ("node-22.23.1-alpine"). Variants: "slim" (glibc, the default) and "alpine". Default "node-22-slim".

root.description: Subdirectory containing this resource, for monorepos (e.g. "apps/api"). Commands run there; the whole repository is still copied.

build.description: Commands that install dependencies and build this resource, run in order in root with the build-scoped entries of env. Default ["npm install"]; an empty list means no build step. Only npm is preinstalled; use "corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile" for pnpm or yarn.

start.description: Commands that start the process, run in order; the last one must keep running and listen on the PORT environment variable. Missing means no process: a client-only site serves its static mounts alone.

static.description: Built directories served by the platform in front of the process, with single-page-app fallback to their index.html. Requests no mount answers are proxied to start. Without start these are the whole app.

path.description: URL prefix the directory is served at, e.g. "/" or "/docs". Longest prefix wins.

dir.description: Directory with the built files, relative to build.root, e.g. "dist".

env.description: Variables the app expects, by name. Declaring one makes it visible in the dashboard; PORT and MODELENCE_* are set by the platform and refused.

type.description: "text" (default) is shown in the dashboard; "secret" is write-only.

scopes.description: Phases the value reaches: "runtime" is the running app, "build" the build commands. Default ["runtime"]; anything a bundler inlines (VITE_*) needs "build".

value.description: A non-secret literal committed with the repo, e.g. a base path. Values that differ per environment, and all secrets, belong in the dashboard.

title: Modelence app spec (version 1)
